import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        seg=t[m.end():].split('\n')
        rows=[]
        for line in seg:
            parts=line.split()
            if len(parts)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in parts):
                rows.append([int(x) for x in parts])
            if len(rows)==h: break
        if len(rows)==h: G[k]=rows
    return G
G=load()
def solve(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(c for r in inp for c in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line={c for c in cnt if any(all(inp[i][j]==c for j in range(W)) for i in range(H)) or any(all(inp[i][j]==c for i in range(H)) for j in range(W))}
    markers=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg and c not in line]
    pts={c:[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==c] for c in markers}
    rs=sorted({p[0] for v in pts.values() for p in v}); cs=sorted({p[1] for v in pts.values() for p in v})
    sr=min(b-a for a,b in zip(rs,rs[1:])); sc=min(b-a for a,b in zip(cs,cs[1:]))
    R=(max(rs)-min(rs))//sr; C=(max(cs)-min(cs))//sc
    o=[[bg]*C for _ in range(R)]
    # anchor per marker color at its min position
    for c in markers:
        i_=(min(p[0] for p in pts[c])-min(rs))//sr; j_=(min(p[1] for p in pts[c])-min(cs))//sc
        o[i_][j_]=c
    return o
print(solve(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        seg=t[m.end():].split('\n')
        rows=[]
        for line in seg:
            parts=line.split()
            if len(parts)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in parts):
                rows.append([int(x) for x in parts])
            if len(rows)==h: break
        if len(rows)==h: G[k]=rows
    return G
G=load()

def solve(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(c for r in inp for c in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # marker colors: rare colors (count < H*W//4) excluding bg
    markers=[c for c,n in cnt.items() if n<H*W//4 and c!=bg]
    pts={c:[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==c] for c in markers}
    # rect top-lefts: for each marker color, find all (r,c) such that (r,sr),(r,c+sc),(r+sr,c) also markers of same color
    rs_all=sorted({p[0] for v in pts.values() for p in v})
    cs_all=sorted({p[1] for v in pts.values() for p in v})
    sr=min(b-a for a,b in zip(rs_all,rs_all[1:])); sc=min(b-a for a,b in zip(cs_all,cs_all[1:]))
    rmin=min(rs_all); cmin=min(cs_all)
    rects={}
    for c,v in pts.items():
        S=set(v)
        for (r,cc) in S:
            if (r+sr,cc) in S and (r,cc+sc) in S and (r+sr,cc+sc) in S:
                rects.setdefault((r-rmin)//sr,[]).append(((cc-cmin)//sc,c))
    oh=max(r for r,_ in rects)+1; ow=max(c for _,c in rects)+1
    return [[next(iter(v)) if (i in rects and j in [c for _,c in rects[i]]) else bg for j in range(ow)] for i in range(oh)]

for i in (1,2):
    ok=solve(G[f'Demo pair {i} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    print(i, ok, solve(G[f'Demo pair {i} input']))
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

from collections import Counter

def analyze(inp, out=None):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0]); cnt=Counter(c for r in inp for c in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    hl=[r for r in range(H) if all(inp[r][c]!=bg for c in range(W))]
    vl=[c for c in range(W) if all(inp[r][c]!=bg for r in range(H))]
    mrks={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c] not in (bg,) and inp[r][c]!=5}
    return bg,hl,vl,mrks

for k in ('Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2'):
    d=G[k+' input']; o=G.get(k+' output')
    bg,hl,vl,mrks=analyze(d)
    print(k,'bg',bg,'hlines',hl,'vlines',vl)
    print('  marker bands:', sorted({(r// (hl[1]-hl[0] if len(hl)>1 else 1), c//(vl[1]-vl[0] if len(vl)>1 else 1)) for r,c in mrks}))
    print('  out:',o)
    # actual band space sizes
    print('  band rows:',len(hl)-1,'band cols:',len(vl)-1)

def f(d):
    H,W=len(d),len(d[0])
    bg=Counter(c for r in d for c in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cnt=Counter(c for r in d for c in r if c!=bg)
    lc=max(cnt,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    step=H//0 if False else None
    # find line period: hlines rows fully non-bg; use spacing between consecutive
    h=[r for r in range(H) if all(x!=bg for x in d[r])]
    v=[c for c in range(W) if all(d[r][c]!=bg for r in range(H))]
    sr=(h[1]-h[0]); sc=(v[1]-v[0])
    mrows=[r for r in h for c in v if d[r][c]!=lc]
    mcols=[c for c in v for r in h if d[r][c]!=lc]
    mr=min(mrows); mc=min(mcols)
    cells={}
    for r in mrows:
        for c in mcols:
            if d[r][c]!=lc:
                i=(r-mr)//sr; j=(c-mc)//sc
                cells.setdefault((i,j),d[r][c])
    Hout=max(i for i,_ in cells)+1; Wout=max(j for _,j in cells)+1
    return [[cells.get((i,j),bg) for j in range(Wout)] for i in range(Hout)]

def f(d):
    H,W=len(d),len(d[0])
    cnt=Counter(c for r in d for c in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rest=[c for c,n in cnt.items() if c!=bg]
    lc=max(rest,key=lambda c:cnt[c]) if len(rest)>1 else None
    h=[r for r in range(H) if all(x!=bg for x in d[r])]
    v=[c for c in range(W) if all(d[r][c]!=bg for r in range(H))]
    sr=h[1]-h[0]; sc=v[1]-v[0]
    mrks=[(r,c,d[r][c]) for r in h for c in v if d[r][c] not in (lc,bg)]
    r0=min(m for _,_,m in mrks); c0=min(c for _,c,_ in mrks)
    R=(max(m for _,_,m in mrks)-r0)//sr+1; C=(max(c for _,c,_ in mrks)-c0)//sc+1
    out=[[bg]*C for _ in range(R)]
    for i in range(R-1):
        for j in range(C-1):
            col=d[h[r0+i*sr]][v[c0+j*sc]]
            if col not in (lc,bg) and all(d[h[r0+i*sr+k*sr]][v[c0+j*sc+l*sc]]==col for k in (0,1) for l in (0,1)):
                out[i][j]=col
    return out
